programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The historic home of JP Speed has morphed into an Arts College, carrying on the legacy of the local entrepreneur’s second wife, Harriet, who was passionate about sharing her love for music and the humanities and is said to still be haunting the home.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Situated near Kentucky's famous Mammoth Caves, the Grand Victorian Inn has carried the hopes of several businesses, residents, educators, and children since it was first erected in 1885. Now, its current owners have experienced a litany of ghostly claims.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Linda Dano
programme.desc: Psychic Medium Kim Russo visits the home of Actress Linda Dano (Another World, One Life To Live) and finally discovers who has been haunting her 18th century house for the past two decades.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Chris McDonald
programme.desc: Christopher McDonald and Kim Russo travel to Christopher's adolescent home in Romulus, NY where he had a ghostly encounter with the other side.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Valerie Harper
programme.desc: Fifty years after her life-altering paranormal experience, Valerie Harper returns to the NYC apartment where she came face to face with the spirit of a woman.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Michael Madsen
programme.desc: Actor Michael Madsen (Reservoir Dogs, Kill Bill) returns deep into the heart of Texas in search of the truth behind an unscripted paranormal experience that has haunted him for nearly a decade.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Unwanted Guest and Mirror Image
programme.desc: A dangerous poltergeist threatens a newly-blended family. A young woman is tormented by visions of her own gruesome death.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Nursery and The Closet
programme.desc: A dangerous entity stalks a pregnant woman in her new house. A single mother discovers a terrifying secret trapped in her son's closet. The shocking eyewitness accounts of terrified people whose dream homes have become nightmares.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mariel Hemingway, Kevin Brown, Curtis Armstrong
programme.desc: A deadly presence inhabits Mariel's home, threatening her very existence; Kevin nearly perishes in a deadly fire when his life is saved by someone from the other side.
programme.sub-title: Mariel Hemingway, Kevin Brown, Curtis Armstrong

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Beverly Johnson, Charlene Tilton, Jimmy Wayne
programme.desc: After the loss of her true love, Beverly is tormented by evil spirits bent on her destruction. Charlene purchases a home haunted by a murdered woman who frightens her.
programme.sub-title: Beverly Johnson, Charlene Tilton, Jimmy Wayne

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: Samtidig som et par ønsker et spedbarn velkommen hjem, begynner et demonisk nærvær å terrorisere dem. Det river deres perfekte verden i filler og gjør livene deres til et mareritt.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: THE COLLECTOR følger opp historien til håndverkeren Arkin, som gjør absolutt alt han kan og mer til for å betale gjelden til sin eks-kone ved å rane hjemmet til sin nye oppdragsgiver.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The remaining models undergo a heavy metallic make-up photo shoot with John Swanell. Lisa arrives at the house and the girls have to critique each other, which causes even more fights. A practical joke gets taken the wrong way.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: With two people gone the house becomes even more divided. The girls meet Saffron Aldridge, top style expert, who goes through their wardrobes with no mercy. They have a one on one with Lisa and the girls are awe-struck when they meet a famous model.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The four remaining models head to Morocco and Lisa gives them the day off. They are given the challenge of finding an outfit for Lisa. They have their first Moroccan photo shoot and the final three are chosen.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: In the finale the three remaining models have their final photo shoot and the final two compete in a catwalk show and one girl is crowned 'Britain's Next Top Model'.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls immediately face their first challenge, posing in front of the press. They then meet stylist Hilary Alexander, who asks them when they lost their virginity and what they think about unprotected sex.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls take part in a catwalk challenge set by Otis Isles, the internationally respected casting director, model agent, and fashion producer, who tells them to dress in underwear.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at the English National Ballet School, where Lisa introduces them to ballet teacher Louise Halliday. They learn about the art of ballet to help with their movement.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls order a pizza and find Lisa Mail for the challenge the following morning. A huge fight breaks out between Stefanie and Louise.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are taken to Debenhams, where they get the chance to meet Caprice. They are given fifteen minutes to find an outfit for different occasions.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at a bar where they meet music video director Paul Hills. Their challenge is to star in a music video along with The Wolfmen.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are woken up by a grueling morning workout from Celebrity Personal Trainer Nicki Waterman. Some struggle with the workout, especially Sherece.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at Models 1, where they meet Mark Evans along with casting agents. They take a Polaroid shot for a casting. Mark announces that they will be going to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, but there are only four places on the plane.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive in Rio and excitedly explore the luxurious villa they will be staying in. On a rare day off, they are driven to Ipanema to play beach volleyball with local guys, and in the evening, they are joined for dinner by Lisa.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The top three girls take a cable car to Sugar Loaf Mountain to learn Samba dancing.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Aptitude and Natural Talent
programme.desc: All 14 girls are interviewed by the press where they are asked why they want to win. The models pair up and pick each partners best and worst features. The girls receive news about their first photoshoot and later find out it's a topless shoot in pairs.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Poise and Composure
programme.desc: The girls get a crash course in dance with top choreographer Supple and a runway lesson from top fashionista Jeanette. The winners get to take part in a fashion show featuring the work of top designer Scottee - whose dresses are all made out of paper.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXI

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXII

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood LXIII

programme.title: Dynasty: The Beating
programme.desc: Steven kunngjør at han flytter ut av herskapshuset. Sjåføren, Michael, forteller Blake om Stevens forhold til Claudia. Fallon gjenopptar forholdet med Michael, inntil Blake får noen til å banke opp sjåføren.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Birthday Party
programme.desc: Blake finner ut at Krystle pantsatte smykket for å hjelpe Matthew. Fallon forteller Jeff at hun giftet seg med ham utelukkende for farens skyld. Stevens tidligere elsker, Ted, kommer til Denver.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Separation
programme.desc: Steven forteller Claudia at han tilbrakte natten med Ted. Krystle forlater Blake. Blake ser at Ted omfavner sønnen hans og angriper Ted. Steven anklager faren sin for mord.

programme.title: Dynasty: Blake Goes To Jail
programme.desc: Blake må i retten for mordet på Stevens elsker. Krystle kommer hjem for å være sammen med Blake. Fallon vitnet på vegne av faren, men Steven tilbakeviser påstandene hennes i retten.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Testimony
programme.desc: Blake hevder sin uskyld i retten. Matthew finner ut om Claudias forhold til Steven. Claudia og datteren, Lindsay, er innblandet i en bilulykke.

programme.title: Dynasty: Enter Alexis
programme.desc: Blakes første kone, Alexis, vitner og påstår at Blake kan være voldelig. Matthew stikker av sammen med Lindsay. Alexis forteller Steven at hun er glad i ham. Juryen kunngjør at de har nådd en avgjørelse.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Verdict
programme.desc: Blake blir funnet skyldig. Krystle gjenforenes med ektemannen. Blake slår Steven. Krystle er gravid og faller. Alexis flytter inn på Carrington-eiendommen.

programme.title: Dynasty: Alexis' Secret
programme.desc: Krystle beordrer Alexis om å forlate herskapshuset. Blake ber advokaten sin om å gjøre Steven arveløs. Claudia prøver å ta selvmord. Alexis forteller Steven at han er Blakes eneste barn.

programme.title: Dynasty: Fallon's Father
programme.desc: Alexis forteller Cecil Colby at Fallon er datteren hans. Blake og Steven oppfordres til å skvære opp. Dr. Toscanni trekker en bevisstløs Steven opp av bassenget og sender ham på sykehuset i all hast.

programme.title: Dynasty: Reconciliation
programme.desc: Steven vender tilbake til herskapshuset for å komme seg etter skadene han fikk da han falt. Krystles niese, Sammy Jo, kommer for å tilbringe noen uker hos Carrigton-familien.

programme.title: Dynasty: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Nick forteller søsteren sin at Blake har skylden for at broren deres døde. Sammy Jo og Steven tilbringer natten sammen. Alexis skyter på Krystles hest.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Miscarriage
programme.desc: Krystle mister babyen. Steven og Sammy Jo begynner å date, selv om Steven er forelsket i Claudia. Fallon fortsetter forholdet med Nick, og blir sjalu når hun oppdager at han besøker Krystle på sykehuset.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Mid-East Meeting
programme.desc: Fallon finner ut at hun er gravid, og forteller Jeff at hun skal ta abort. Han går med på å skille seg, men bare hvis hun beholder barnet. Krystle sørger fortsatt over tapet av babyen.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Psychiatrist
programme.desc: Alexis lurer Blake til å komme til Roma og narrer ham i en felle ved å leie en snikfotograf til å ta suspekte bilder av dem. Jeff bønnfaller Fallon om å ikke ta abort.

programme.title: Dynasty: Sammy Jo and Steven Marry
programme.desc: Nick forteller Krystle at han elsker henne. Steven og Sammy Jo gifter seg. Fallon avlyser aborten. Etter skandalen forårsaket av paparazzibildene av Alexis og Blake, forlater Krystle Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Car Explosion
programme.desc: Nick overtaler Krystle til å gå fra Blake. Steven og Sammy Jo kunngjør at de er gift. Blake angripes av gangstere og blir blindet når bilen hans bombes.

programme.title: Dynasty: Blake's Blindness
programme.desc: Blake er fortsatt blind etter eksplosjonen. Nick ber Krystle om å skille seg fra ektemannen og gifte seg med ham. Blake graver i Nicks fortid. Alexis er fast bestemt på å fordrive Krystle fra Denver.

programme.desc: Danny Farrell's newfound ability to spread promicin leads to several hundred deaths, including his mother. With Seattle in chaos, NTAC is forced to accept Promise City's offer of help.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.sub-title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series - 5min

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Forced to stop at a motel, Seth makes a plan with Carlos to cross the border while Richie struggles with his visions.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Attempting to leave the motel undetected, the Gecko Brothers take the Fuller family hostage.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: After a daring escape, Seth leads the Fuller's RV to the border crossing while an irrational fear takes hold of Richie.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: The Geckos and Fullers get more than they bargained for when they enter the Titty Twister; Seth senses his deal with Carlos may be slipping away.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.sub-title: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named

programme.title: Gabulosis: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy
programme.desc: In June 2006, construction workers in Sutherland, Saskatoon, Canada uncovered the remains of an unidentified woman from the early 1900s. Her name and story remained a mystery for another 19 years.
programme.sub-title: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy

programme.sub-title: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi och Lauren har ett nytt offentligt gräl, som får Heidi att komma tillbaka och be Lauren om ursäkt för allt som hänt. Audrinas relation med Justin går på i gamla hjulspår, men karriären på Epic Records tar fart.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leker äktenskapsmäklare när Whitney går på sin första dejt med deras personlige tränare. Spencer motarbetar Heidis planer för ett sagobröllop, med ett gräl som hotar förlovningen som resultat.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina får syn på Justin när han kysser en annan tjej, vilket leder till en slutlig konfrontation om deras relation. Heidi blir chockad när Spencers syster Stephanie muckar gräl med Lauren och Brody på en nattklubb.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror att Brody kanske är för mycket av en playboy, för att hon ska kunna mena allvar med honom. Spencers syster berättar för honom att Heidi i hemlighet hyser tvivel inför deras bröllop.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får höra spännande nyheter på Teen Vogue och Heidi behöver komma bort från Spencer ett tag.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer äntligen iväg till Paris, men hennes drömresa blir nästan förstörd när hon upptäcker att Brody har hittat en ny. Spencer följer efter Heidi till Colorado, för att vinna tillbaka henne, men planen går i baklås.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney måste välja mellan tryggheten på Teen Vogue och riskerna med en ny karriär. Lauren och Brody hamnar i konflikt om hans nya flickvän och Heidi anpassar sig till ett liv utan Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en osannolik vän när Spenders syster Stephanie börjar på hennes modekurs. Whitney tycker att det nya jobbet är som en dröm, men en hektisk resa till New York får henne att minnas att man ska vara försiktig med vad man önskar sig.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: När Lauren bjuder Stephanie på sin födelsedagsfest ifrågasätter Heidi och Spencer Stephanies lojalitet. Spencer sjösätter en plan för att vinna tillbaka Heidi.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Charming Charlie
programme.desc: Kan Charlie charma sig loss från två ilskna ex? Chloes osäkerhet tar över, och tre personers framtid i villan står på spel.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: If Looks Could Kill
programme.desc: Villan är i chock efter ett trippelavsked. Nads & Charlie kan vara på väg mot katastrof, medan Jay & Tasha kommer närmare varandra. Chloe ändrar sig om Ozzie, men är det lite för sent?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Chloe hoppar mellan kärlekstrianglarna, Nadia får en trevlig överraskning, och en explosiv dubbeleliminering tar hårt på ett par.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Make Ups And Break Ups
programme.desc: Ozzies kärlekstriangel får ett dramatiskt slut, en bisarr olycka chockar villan, och Charlie ställs inför ett svårt val.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Villan skakas om när en OG lämnar. Kan Charlie charma sig ur ännu mer trubbel? En känslosam final orsakar oväntad hjärtesorg.
programme.sub-title: He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Zahida Wages War
programme.desc: Åtta sexiga singlar upptäcker att deras dröm om sommarkärlek blir en mardröm när allt fler ex än nånsin kommer för att skapa kaos. Zahida krigar med Maisie om Sean, men det är när det första exet kommer som den verkliga förödelsen sker.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Sea Of Tears
programme.desc: Det kokar i villan när inte bara ett utan tre ex anländer och skapar kaos för turturduvorna Ross och Harriette. Zahidas ex Joe tappar kontrollen och Alex hotar att dränka sig i tårar.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Love Triangle
programme.desc: Singlarnas elände fortsätter när Sean rör sig från Zahida till Zaralena, och Harriettes kärlekstriangel blir värre. Maisie vill att nåt ska hända och Aaron från Geordie Shore gör spektakulär entré, men vem av exen är hans?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Nicole's Nightmare
programme.desc: Det blir spänt i villan när Zaralena får känna på Zahidas vrede. Det nya exet skapar revirtänkande hos killarna. Josh har ögonen på Nicole, men tar det slut när hon upptäcker en fruktansvärd hemlighet?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Blonde Bombshell
programme.desc: Adam avslöjar sina känslor för Nicole, och Jack och Josh vill ha nytt blod i villan. Zaralena och Aaron kommer närmare varandra, och Ross och Harriette tillbringar natten i takvåningen. Men ett nytt ex är olycksbådande för dem alla.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Hearthache
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan ställer till det för Becca. Harriettes hjärtesorg blir värre och Zaralenas elände fortsätter, men det är det senaste exet som hotar skapa det värsta kaoset.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth Comes Out
programme.desc: Ankomsten av ett nytt ex skapar kaos i villan. Nicole inser sanningen om Jacques Fraser, medan det är svajigt mellan Ross och Harriette igen. Zaralena fattar ett stort beslut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Jacques Comeuppance
programme.desc: Jacques Fraser får till slut sitt straff. Det nyaste exet stormar stranden och villan, sätter en kil mellan Sean och Zahida, och skapar kaos för resten.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Aaron Moves On
programme.desc: Två nya ex kommer, till Aarons glädje och Beccas förtvivlan. Maisie når sin absoluta botten, Harriette får en spektakulär härdsmälta, och Sean och Jack brakar samman.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan tillkännager ett stort grekiskt bröllop för Sean och Zahida, men när det sista exet kommer blir det kaos av firandet. Harriette får chockerande besked från Ross.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Welcome to Ex on the Beach
programme.desc: Tio profiler från realityvärlden och sociala medier tror att de är på en sexig semester, men paradiset blir en mardröm när deras ex börjar komma upp på stranden och förstöra nöjet. Blir det nytändningar eller bara bråk?
programme.sub-title: Welcome to Ex on the Beach

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Exed Out
programme.desc: Ett nytt ex kommer med en hemlighet som skakar om huset. Ett av exen röstas bort, och par och tidigare par får möta sina värsta mardrömmar i Hemlighålet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Two Exes Don't Make a Right
programme.desc: Huset får avgöra vem som har det värst, när en singel hamnar i kläm mellan två ex och en annan får möta sitt värsta ex. En sexig dejt urartar i kaos.
programme.sub-title: Two Exes Don't Make a Right

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Wanna Call You Babe
programme.desc: Angela vänder sig till sitt ex när hon får veta vad som hände mellan hennes karl och en annan. De två kvinnorna som slåss om Chase börjar plötsligt slåss om husets nya kille.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Who's Exed Next?
programme.desc: Exen får överraskande nog all makt, Derrick smider planer och försöker manipulera huset, två nya ex anländer, och den ena är mer välkommen än den andra.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy
programme.desc: Jada blir arg när Uche konfronterar hennes flört med Clinton, två till-och-från-par är tillsammans igen, och tjejernas familjer delar med sig av pinsamma berättelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Sinking Relation-ships
programme.desc: Nurys kan inte acceptera relationen mellan Malcolm och Diandra, och i huset råder det konflikt mellan paren som vägrar splittras och singlarna som har svårt att få kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray
programme.desc: Kareem och Alexis blir pressade när Alivia och Keith tror att de kan vara ett perfekt par. Några ex kommer på besök, bland annat ett som alla redan känner.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey blir paranoid när hon ser Michael klicka med Geles, Malcolm får sota för sina playerfasoner, och huset börjar undersöka nya kontakter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Svartsjukan är i centrum under en vild Mard Gras-fest. Geles blir huvudfienden när hon raggar på flera killar i huset. Dimitri hamnar i dålig dager hos Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vill lämna Nicoles kompisbubbla, och Shad visar känslor. Huset präglas av hjärtesorg och svartsjuka, när alla sätter sitt hopp till Keith för en strategisk vinst.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Ceremonin väntar, och huset vill desperat få in rätt par i sanningsbåset och få fram elva perfekta par. Keith och Alexis pressar varandra över gränsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Värden Terrence J ger en exklusiv inblick i den här säsongens AYtO-deltagare och berättar varför de här 22 singlarna suger på förhållanden.
programme.sub-title: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Efter flera veckors jakt på kärlek och pengar samlas deltagarna från säsong sex igen, för att avslöja hemligheter om explosiva ögonblick, okänd dramatik, och vad som har hänt sen de lämnade huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 2
programme.desc: Efter flera veckors jakt på kärlek och pengar samlas deltagarna från säsong sex igen, för att avslöja hemligheter om explosiva ögonblick, okänd dramatik, och vad som har hänt sen de lämnade huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Leap of Fate
programme.desc: 22 singlar testar ÖDET och flyttar in i ett hus på Hawaii för att försöka hitta de elva perfekta paren och vinna en miljon dollar. Svartsjuka löper amok när de snabbt bildar par.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Flirt at Your Own Risk
programme.desc: Zak får känna på Brias vrede när han flörtar med andra kvinnor och hela huset dras med i dramatiken. Tevins och Kenyas raggningsvanor hotar deras spirande romans.

programme.title: Are You The One?: With Frenemies Like These...
programme.desc: Zak utforskar sina valmöjligheter medan kvinnorna slåss om honom. Kenya och Jasmine blir officiellt fiender.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name
programme.desc: Asia blir sårad när hon får veta vad hennes vän och hennes flört har gjort. Romansen mellan Kali och Brett äventyras av deras dåliga dejtingvanor.
programme.sub-title: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Huset skakas om när deras ex hälsar på. Det blir spänt när ex hotar att splittra ett starkt par, och en annan blir aggressiv. Zak slits mellan Bria och Morgan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Spilling The Tea
programme.desc: Kwasi orsakar tumult när han avslöjar vad Tevin och Jasmine gjorde igår kväll. Bria blir arg på relationen mellan Morgan och Zak, och deltagarna tar en risk när de ska välja partner.

programme.title: Are You The One?: He Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Cam ifrågasätter sin relation med Kayla, Daniels skojeri driver bort Sam, och huset står inför det hittills viktigaste Sanningsbåset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beast Mode
programme.desc: Spänningar uppstår mellan Cam och Kwasi när Kwasi stöter på Kayla. Asia får ett utbrott när hon tror att vissa personer i huset är skumma. Zak måste göra ett val.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa är tänd på Brett, och Bretts oförmåga att glömma Cali får följder för hela huset. Moe pressas att börja spela spelet. Lewis avslöjar sina känslor för Asia.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besatthet av Zak och Zaks player-attityd hotar husets förmåga att spela spelet. Cali kommer på en plan för hur man ska klura ut vilka av paren som är bekräftade par och vilka som inte är det.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: På en vild fest gör tvivelaktigt beteende bästa vänner till ovänner. Tevin och Kenya gör sig redo att möta sitt öde. Moe pressas att prestera bättre.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Are You The One?: Caught On Kiss Cam
programme.desc: Kwasi och Jasmines relation äventyras när en bekant fiende lägger sig i. Starka par försöker knyta nya kontakter.

programme.title: I morgon börjar allt
programme.desc: Samuel, en man vars bekymmerslösa liv på Franska Rivieran vänds upp och ner när Kristin, som han haft en kortare romans med, plötsligt dyker upp och presenterar honom för deras nyfödda dotter Gloria. Kristin överlämnar Gloria med varm hand i hans vårdnad.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris är en ung, vacker men pank tennistränare som blir involverad i en rik familj genom att träna en av familjemedlemmarna. Kärleksaffärer med två kvinnor samtidigt tvingar honom att begå ett allvarligt brott.

programme.title: Wonder Boys
programme.desc: En engelsk professor försöker handskas med att hans fru lämnar honom, att hans förläggare som har väntat på hans bok i sju år anländer och de olika problem som hans vänner och medarbetare drar in honom i.

programme.title: Jimmy P.
programme.desc: En orolig indianveteran bildar en exceptionell vänskap med en fransk psykoanalytiker när de försöker hitta botemedel mot deras lidande.

programme.title: Legend (Director's Cut)
programme.desc: Ett visuellt makalösa äventyr som utspelas i en tidlösmytologisk skog bebodd av älvor, troll, enhörningar ochdödliga, utses Jack att rädda Prinsessan Lili.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Pfeiffer spelar Frankie, en servitris i ett kafé i New York. Efter en rad smärtsamma relationer, vill hon absolut inte ha någon ny man i sitt liv...tills han ger sig till känna.

programme.title: Powder Blue
programme.desc: I Los Angeles skuggsida – långt ifrån neonljus och berömmelse – kämpar fyra separata människor en kamp mot ett ensamt och tröstlöst liv.

programme.title: Nana's Secret Recipe
programme.desc: Fem kvinnor som förlorat sina pensionssparande i ett Ponzi-bedrägeri öppnar ett bageri tillsammans. Ett magiskt recept kan återställa deras pengar, men när en knarklangare får veta om ingredienserna hamnar de i knipa.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1990s, one criminal terrorized an entire community. Witnesses refused to speak out. They knew the consequences could be deadly.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the streets of New York flooded with crack cocaine in the 1980's a wave of violence threatened to drown the city. Colombian cartels brought the coke in and ran their operations with an iron fist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: 100 Below Zero
programme.desc: When a chain of volcanic eruptions rips through Europe, the enormous ash cloud blocks out the sun, plunging the continent into a new ice age. An American couple must find their college-aged kids and get them out of Paris before it freezes over.

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: John, en ganska misslyckad äventyrare som fastnat i Reno, har nästan slut på pengar när Sydney bjuder honom på frukost och ger honom tips om hur man tjänar pengar i casinon. Två år senare är John Sydneys partner.

programme.title: Man On The Moon
programme.desc: Den legendariske komikern Andy Kaufmans liv och karriär.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Mitch kommer hem från en mindre angenäm affärsresa en kväll och ertappar sin fru Heidi i en trekant med två främlingar som bär ögonbindel.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady har bott i Afrika och vet inte hur 'vilt' det kan vara i civilisationen förrän hon möter en av världens elakaste arter, 'bidrottningen', som på den här skolan är den coola och beräknande Regina George.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Någon har tagit din längtan efter uppföljare för långt! De komiska favoritfigurerna från SCARY MOVIE är tillbaka i en film som skrämmer upp ännu mer kul än originalet med dess klyschiga syn på thrillers om hemsökta hus.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: I fyra år har den modiga NSEA-styrkan spelat in en tv-serie där de varit med om spännande och farliga uppdrag i rymden. Plötsligt ställs tv-serien in!

programme.title: P.S.
programme.desc: En nyligen skild kvinna får chansen att återuppleva sitt förflutna när hon träffar en ung man som verkar vara hennes gymnasiekärlek, som dog många år tidigare.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: Den "svarta får"-sonen av en förmögen familj möter en ung psykiatrisk patient som har växt upp i isolering hela sitt liv. Han tar med sig denna naiva unga kvinna hem till sin brors bröllop.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En erfaren lönnmördare får problem när han blir kär i sitt mål, en charmig svindlare som inte tänker gå ner utan en fight.

programme.title: The One I Love
programme.desc: Ett par i kris försöker rädda sitt förhållande på en helgresa.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Plenty of Chances
programme.desc: Police investigate a gunshot outside a nightclub, a marijuana-growing operation is dismantled, a domestic dispute suspect tries to flee police.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Moors Murders
programme.desc: An investigation into the Moors Murderers, Myra Hindley and Ian Brady, with interviews with the family of Keith Bennett.

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: Jack the Ripper. The most famous serial killer in history, we reveal the true lives of the five women slain.

programme.title: 72 Hours
programme.desc: 1995 - Houston, Texas. A lonely man calls a dating service and gets more than he bargained for when he is met at gunpoint and robbed by his “dates”. The women, dubbed “Thelma & Louise”, lure men with the promise of sex but then drug and rob them.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A Montana town is stunned when building contractor Larry Streeter is murdered by Teddy Ernst, a popular wheelchair-racing champ.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: Fugitive Justice
programme.desc: Respected neurosurgeon Sam Sheppard is found guilty of brutally killing his wife, despite his pleas of innocence. His story captures a nation and becomes the basis for the hugely popular television series and film,

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 205 - Charity Frauds (Illness/Disaster)
programme.desc: Society?s altruism can be easily affirmed through the donations given to charities in times of need - however, there are individuals out there that want to exploit these good-natured donations and re-direct them into their own pockets.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Hemlock Killer
programme.desc: When a woman is poisoned by an obscure plant, detectives launch an undercover operation to outsmart a bookish murder mystery buff with a short fuse.

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: Jack the Ripper. The most famous serial killer in history, we reveal the true lives of the five women slain.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Cameron Walker finds his dad dead in bed and his mom bound in the closet. When the woman's story as to what happened doesn’t add up, police turn to Dr. G to uncover the true killer.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Mommie Dearest
programme.desc: A woman is bludgeoned to death in her own home, and her severely handicapped teenage daughter goes missing. When investigators eventually catch up with the young woman, they hear a baffling story of a mother's toxic love.

programme.title: Miami Water Cops
programme.desc: Today, clandestine swimming: the Special Ops learn the ropes of spy swimming.

programme.title: Courage in Red: VIP Protection
programme.desc: A new group of students try to make the grade in the RCMP’s prestigious National VIP protection program.

programme.title: Courage in Red: K9 (Police Dog Services)
programme.desc: RCMP K9, exploring the special bond between handler and dog as they police the frontlines of Canada.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 203 - Counterfeit Sports Memorabilia / Product
programme.desc: In the world of sports memorabilia, counterfeit products can make criminals rich.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 213 - Elder Fraud
programme.desc: Follow the stories of elderly people whose retirement savings were plundered by everyone from their trusted fiduciaries, new romantic interests, and even their own children.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Anne Grigg-Booth
programme.desc: Anne Grigg-Booth, who was responsible for administering painkilling injections to patients, was a heavy drinker with a passion for drugs. We hear from the doctor that Grigg-Booth's team lined up as an expert witness in her defence.

programme.title: Miami Water Cops
programme.desc: Today the Water Cops get tough with trespassers and the Security Students start on gruelling weapons training exercises in the wake of last week’s failure.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Sally Anne Bowman
programme.desc: A look at the murder of 18-year-old Sally Anne Bowman, who was stabbed in Croydon in 2005. With interviews with her family and detectives who solved the case.

programme.title: American Justice
programme.desc: When an Army Sergeant is gunned down at home on New Year's Eve, investigators are at a loss on who would harm the beloved family man, until fellow soldiers in his unit confess shocking secrets to solve his murder.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Bludgeons and Dragons
programme.desc: Envy rears its ugly head in the sordid tale of a successful geek and two down-on-their-luck jocks.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Emoji Overkill
programme.desc: A Texas father takes his spoiled teenage daughter to an exclusive Caribbean resort and somehow ends up packed in his own suitcase.

programme.title: Tourist Police: Thailand
programme.desc: We head east and join the Thai police as more tourists are in trouble.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Come Out Swinging
programme.desc: Police attend a bloody machete attack, a citizen threatens officer with a golf club and shots are fired in a residential neighborhood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.desc: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.
programme.sub-title: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)

programme.title: South Park: Rödhåriga ungar
programme.desc: Cartman lider av 'Gingervitus' och går till kamp mot förföljelsen av rödhåriga.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Facebook visar sig vara professor Chaos ultimata vapen.

programme.title: South Park: The Passion of the Jew
programme.desc: Efter att ha sett 'The Passion of the Christ' gör Cartman livet svårt för Kyle, medan en sinnesrubbad Mel Gibson jagar Stan och Kenny tillbaka till stan efter att de bett om sina pengar tillbaka.

programme.title: South Park: Världens största as
programme.desc: Efter att Cartman druckit Kennys aska och uppfyllts av hans själ känner hans sig inte riktigt bra och måste tas till sjukhuset.

programme.title: South Park: Låt dem äta gegga
programme.desc: Cartman är säker på att den nya växtbaserade maten i skolan gav honom en hjärtattack.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey, julbajskorven
programme.desc: Borgmästaren bestämmer sig för att införa ett oförargligt helgtema som inte väcker anstöt hos någon. Kyle tror att han har svaret.

programme.title: South Park: Osäkerhet
programme.desc: Kyle och Ike tror att deras mamma vänstrar med paketbudet, och Cartman köper ett inbrottslarm.

programme.title: South Park: Kul med kampsportvapen
programme.desc: Efter att pojkarna köpt kampsportsvapen på en lokal loppmarknad förvandlas de till animerade japanska krigare vilket får förödande konsekvenser för Butters.

programme.title: South Park: Help, My Teenager Hates Me!
programme.desc: Pojkarna upptäcker att det roliga med Airsoft också medför en utmaning i att ha med tonåringar att göra.

programme.title: South Park: Det galna antastningsäventyret
programme.desc: Kyle ringer polisen för att rapportera att hans föräldrar antastar honom. Snart anger alla barnen sina föräldrar, tills det bara finns barn kvar i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: F-ordet
programme.desc: Killarna tar strid mot de högljudda och jobbiga motorcyklisterna som stör lugnet i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Släpp taget och styr
programme.desc: Cartman infiltrerar NSA för att avslöja dem och blir inte alls glad över vad han hittar i sin egen personakt.

programme.title: South Park: Förskolan
programme.desc: Pojkarna hamnar i hett vatten när en kille de satte dit för att ha satt eld på en lärare släpps ut från ungdomsfängelset.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en analsond
programme.desc: Cartman drömmer att han träffar en utomjording. De andra pojkarna övertygar honom att drömmen att sann och att han har utsatts för en utomjordisk analundersökning.

programme.title: South Park: För mycket information
programme.desc: Efter en pinsam händelse som involverade intima pojkdelar skickas Cartman för att lära sig kontrollera sin vrede, medan Randy får ta hand om efterverkningarna så gott han kan.

programme.title: South Park: Fabulös och modig
programme.desc: Killarna visar Caitlyn Jenner sin enormt stora respekt i det mest fabulösa och modiga 'South Park'-avsnittet nånsin.

programme.title: South Park: Sextrackar-Pandan
programme.desc: Cartman stämmer Stan för sexuellt ofredande.

programme.title: South Park: Att använda kondom
programme.desc: Tack vare Stan måste barnen i South Park stå ut med sexualundervisning från den osannolika duon Mr Mackey och Ms Choksondik.

programme.title: South Park: Familjen Jefferson
programme.desc: En ny familj anländer till South Park med en liten pojke som heter Blanket, en nöjesplats i trädgården och en pappa med en förkärlek för musik och plastikkirurgi. Gissa vem det är!

programme.title: South Park: Nitiska ninjor
programme.desc: Invånarna i South Park bestämmer sig för att de inte längre behöver en poliskår.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankeys julklassiker
programme.desc: I det här specialavsnittet visas inslag från Mr Hankeys julalbum.

programme.title: South Park: Det luktar fisk
programme.desc: En skvallerhemsida blir populär på South Park Elementary och det tar hus i helvete. Vem kommer att lösa situationen, Cartman eller gerbilkungen Lemmiwinks?

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle bjuder in Butters istället för Cartman till sitt födelsekalas. Cartman övertygar Butters att en meteor kommer att kollidera med jorden och låser in honom i ett skyddsrum så att han kan gå istället.

programme.title: South Park: City People
programme.desc: Cartman blir inte glad när hans mamma får ett nytt jobb.

programme.title: South Park: Är du där, Gud? Det är jag, Jesus.

programme.title: iCarly: iMöter rikets första dam

programme.title: iCarly: iTån och Fat Cakes

programme.title: iCarly: iSynproblem

programme.title: iCarly: iApril April!
programme.desc: I det här speciella aprilskämt-avsnittet blir Carly och Spencer vräkta, så gänget sitter och tänker tillbaka på sin tid i Bushwell Plaza. Men deras minnen stämmer kanske inte riktigt alltid överens med hur vi minns händelserna.

programme.title: iCarly: iPearbutiken

programme.title: iCarly: iTappade huvudet i Las Vegas
